 UIC student arrested, student center evacuated after attempted on-campus stabbing
 One student was arrested and the other student was unharmed, according to University of Illinois officials. No injuries were reported.
 By  
 Mary Norkol 
 [month] [day], [year], [hour]:[minute][ampm] [timezone] 
 The student center at the University of Illinois-Chicago was evacuated Wednesday after an attempted stabbing.
 Sun-Times file photo

 A University of Illinois Chicago student was arrested after an attempted stabbing in the school’s student center Wednesday afternoon, university officials said.
 The stabbing attempt was reported on the second floor of the school’s Student Center East, 750 S. Halsted St., Wednesday afternoon. The other student involved wasn’t stabbed or injured, according to a UIC spokesperson.
 The student center was evacuated and will be closed while the investigation continues.
 UIC police are investigating. Chicago police referred the Chicago Sun-Times to UIC for information on the incident.
